svg.text: Plan or brief saved before sending (e.g. only step 1 filled)
Client presses Submit on a brief or plan
Planner picks up the brief and builds the media plan
Planner sends the plan to a manager before the client sees it
Manager approves internally; plan is shared with the client
Client or manager asks for changes
Client approves the plan; IO signed or budget booked
Campaign set up in the DSP; start date is in the future
Start date reached, delivery starts (data from day 3)
Delivery paused: budget, creative or client request
End date reached; final report is available
Archived manually or after the campaign closes
★ added during reconstruction, to be checked against the original map
